diagnostics.name: mixed-signedness-arithmetic
diagnostics.message: UInt and SInt arithmetic requires an explicit signedness decision.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use toSigned, toUnsigned, or a reinterpretation operation deliberately.

diagnostics.name: physical-dimension-mismatch
diagnostics.message: Physical quantities with incompatible dimensions cannot be combined.
diagnostics.suggestion: Convert through an explicit dimensioned model or correct the expression.

diagnostics.name: interface-stored-as-data
diagnostics.message: Interface connectivity cannot be stored in a register or memory.
diagnostics.suggestion: Store a directionless Struct payload instead.

diagnostics.name: interface-used-as-payload
diagnostics.message: An Interface endpoint cannot be used as a Valid or Stream payload.
diagnostics.suggestion: Define a storable Struct payload and keep connectivity separate.

diagnostics.name: monitor-drive
diagnostics.message: A monitor role cannot drive an interface member.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use a driving role or keep the access observational.

diagnostics.name: invalid-role-inversion
diagnostics.message: The selected role has no legal automatic inverse.
diagnostics.suggestion: Declare an explicit complementary role or adapter module.

diagnostics.name: illegal-open-drain-drive
diagnostics.message: Open-drain endpoints cannot drive arbitrary values.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use driveLow(enable) and highZ().

diagnostics.name: protocol-or-interface-mismatch
diagnostics.message: Exact connection requires one interface identity and complementary roles.
diagnostics.suggestion: Insert an explicit adapter module for protocol conversion.

diagnostics.name: unapproved-systemverilog-backend
diagnostics.message: Backend.SystemVerilog is not part of public API v0.3.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use Backend.Auto or Backend.Verilog; await the separately gated backend.

diagnostics.name: ordinary-always-removed
diagnostics.message: Ordinary synchronous always(event) is not in the v0.3 public subset.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use ClockDomain, Reg or RegNext, and when/elsewhen/otherwise.

diagnostics.name: pipeline-without-domain
diagnostics.message: A pipeline region containing dynamic hardware has no lexical clock domain.
diagnostics.suggestion: Declare or inherit one ClockDomain before creating the region.

diagnostics.name: cross-domain-pipeline-capture
diagnostics.message: A pipeline transform captures a value from another domain without a crossing.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use an explicit CDC or RDC primitive before entering the transaction.

diagnostics.name: unrelated-live-pipeline-capture
diagnostics.message: A dynamic value used by a transform did not enter through its transaction.
diagnostics.suggestion: Add the value to the transaction payload or make it static.

diagnostics.name: unbounded-published-auto-latency
diagnostics.message: A published fixed-rate boundary cannot expose unconstrained automatic latency.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use Latency.Exact, Latency.Range, or keep the region internal.

diagnostics.name: external-model-or-effect-missing
diagnostics.message: An external operation lacks required latency, effect, domain, or model evidence.
diagnostics.suggestion: Provide a complete ExternalContract or VariableLatencyContract.

diagnostics.name: multiple-ordinary-drivers
diagnostics.message: An ordinary signal or state value has multiple unrelated drivers.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use one priority update root or a declared resolved digital net.

diagnostics.name: unsupported-internal-resolution
diagnostics.message: The selected backend profile cannot implement this internal resolved net.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use a boundary inout, split carrier, or technology-mapped adapter.

diagnostics.name: implicit-mixed-signal-conversion
diagnostics.message: Digital, conservative, and signal-flow values cannot convert implicitly.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use an explicit bridge with timing, threshold, quantization, and model metadata.

diagnostics.name: backend-interface-layout-mismatch
diagnostics.message: The requested interface layout is unsupported by the selected backend.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use PortableFlattened or select a future separately approved capability.

diagnostics.name: flattened-interface-name-collision
diagnostics.message: Two logical interface members map to the same emitted port name.
diagnostics.suggestion: Choose a unique flatten prefix or revise the logical member names.

diagnostics.name: unbounded-or-runtime-hardware-loop
diagnostics.message: A target-visible loop has no static or bounded symbolic limit.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use Scala elaboration, generate, or LoopBound.Symbolic with a maximum.

diagnostics.name: invalid-fsm-contract
diagnostics.message: An FSM has invalid encoding, transition, recursion, or illegal-state metadata.
diagnostics.suggestion: Provide canonical enum encoding and a finite verified statechart contract.
